discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 54c7ed2b7. The specialty helper now copies headers from getUnifiedModelsResponse, resets Content-Type, and removes content-length after filtering. Added regression coverage that verifies x-request-id and x-model-catalog-version are preserved.
Fixed. Terminated enqueued flushed chunks with double newlines (\n\n) to serve as a proper SSE event separator, preventing the enqueued tail from merging with subsequent sentinel/stop chunks.

**Timeout para chamada externa ao OpenRouter**
- Adicionado `AbortController` com timeout (7s) em:
  - `src/app/api/settings/qdrant/embedding-models/route.ts`
- Evita request pendente indefinida e melhora resiliência.
